reading: The refusals are not uniform, and the distribution is the useful part. The graph's own parallel layer asserts 89 EXACT_PARALLEL_OF and 415 VARIANT_OF edges between Samavedic and Rigvedic verses -- 504 edges -- while letter identity reaches 216 verses. The two disagree because the parallel layer folds sandhi and this does not: sandhi changes word boundaries, and a morphological analysis is per word, so a sandhi-insensitive match is not a licence to transfer one. The near-miss bands are the queue for a philologist: a verse at 0.99 containment differs from its Rigvedic source by one or two letters and a human can say in seconds whether the differing word changes its analysis.
what_this_is_not: Not a Samavedic morphological annotation. Not a claim about a Samavedic recension's reading beyond the identity of the string. Not about the gana: the sung saman, its stobhas and its melodic text are a different object and every projected row says so.
